feeds.title: Henna Brows Blog
feeds.description: Henna Brows International is one of the fastest Henna ranges on the market. It can take as little as 3-20 mins (depending on the client's existing brows, desired look, etc). Henna Brows come in easy-to-use sachets with no waste.

feeds.title: Jeevi Brow Studio Blog
feeds.description: We are a full-service brow studio that offers a range of services from eyebrow threading, and brow & lash tinting to eyelash extensions, lash lifts, brow lamination, brow henna, and waxing. Treat yourself to a relaxing and calming experience. With our friendly and well-trained staff, you are in the best hands. Let us pamper you. You deserve it!

feeds.title: Ira Bale Blog
feeds.description: Ira Bale Brows is a friendly, contemporary, and welcoming beauty salon in South Yarra. We pride ourselves on our commitment to providing a professional and friendly, speedy yet relaxing experience for our clients whilst maintaining the highest quality of work. We provide the finest eyebrows and eyelash services like Brow Shaping, Threading, Henna Brows, Lash Lift, Tint, and Microblading.

feeds.title: The Eyebrow Specialist Blog
feeds.description: The Eyebrow Specialist is a boutique eyebrow salon located in Sunnybank Hills, Brisbane. We are a women-led salon serving women with all their eyebrow and beauty needs - from shaping and tinting to waxing and facials, we've got you covered.

feeds.title: The Brow Fixx Blog
feeds.description: My aim is to provide my clients with high-quality treatments, tailor-made to suit each person, in a relaxing and serene environment. I can truly say I love what I do, and as the old saying goes, if you love what you do, you'll never work a day in your life! We specialise in eyebrow and facial waxing, threading, keratin brow lamination, ombré powder brows & lash lift services.

feeds.title: Powder Brows By Claudia Blog
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Claudia, I fell in love with the convenience of permanent makeup and I have been obsessed with brows ever since! Many training's later, with the best artists in the industry, here I am wanting to help as many women as I can achieve a beautiful, natural look that they can wake up to every day.

feeds.title: Monarch Brow And Facials Studio Blog
feeds.description: A professional aesthetician since 2000, Angela launched Monarch Brow & Facial in 2016, providing expert skincare treatments, organic facials, and lash and eyebrow tinting. Monarch Brow and Facial Studio blog contain information about microblading, micro pigmentation, brow tattooing, and facials featuring the Lumenis Oxygeneo machine.

feeds.title: Brow Code Blog
feeds.description: Brow Code has been leading the way in the brow styling game since 2017. Our revolutionary range of brow-focused products is developed to the highest of standards, exceeding the expectations of professional stylists worldwide. Covering all aspects of Professional Brow Styling, we have crafted a complete line to meet the growing demand of stylists across the world to create and maintain the perfect brow for their clients.

feeds.title: Brows & Co Blog
feeds.description: Brows & Co. was founded in 2016 to provide the best solutions for women who wanted a full and natural eyebrow look with minimum upkeep. We were founded to help women create multiple looks that fit into their daily lives. We also create stress-free brows that give women a great start and a boost in confidence.

feeds.title: Impressive Brows Blog
feeds.description: Founded in Feb of 2017 by Pranee Linder, Impressive Brows is a Christian permanent makeup academy and clinic that offers permanent makeup services and training for brows, lips, eyeliner, and scalp. We specialize in brows with over 15,000 clients and multiple locations around central Florida. Our mission is to unlock your beauty potential, spread the gospel, and glorify the Lord.

feeds.title: Browly Care Blog
feeds.description: We are here to revolutionize the world of brows. We believe it's time to have a one-stop-shop for brow products. We've made it our mission to put an end to the jungle of products and decided to develop something from scratch instead of trying to make existing beauty products better.

feeds.title: Ardour Brows & Lashes Blog
feeds.description: Here at ARDOUR Brows & Lashes, we are a true reflection of our name. We are committed to providing you and your beloved brows and lashes the best possible experience. We pride ourselves on having an amazing team of experienced Ardour Artists who aim to deliver exceptional service and results in every time. If you're looking for a lash lift, brow shaping, and tint or classic lash extension we've got you covered.

feeds.title: Fab Brows Blog
feeds.description: We provide a natural look that goes above and beyond satisfaction for every individual. As Fab Brows is available on a global scale, we strive to maintain the identity of each and every one of our customers. Our powder palettes match every color, shape, definition, and tone. With consistent care and nurturing, it is our mission to connect with our customers emotionally as giving them specialized cosmetics helps them glow with confidence and come out of their shells to become the person they want to be.

feeds.title: Aphrodite's Secret Blog » Eyebrow
feeds.description: Aphrodite's Secret is a skincare and permanent makeup clinic in East Lansing that specializes in detailed brow shaping, ombre brows, customized skincare regimens, and more. The Eybrow blog section of the website is your detailed guide to microblading and ombre.

feeds.title: Basia Brow & Beauty Blog
feeds.description: Basia is a fully qualified Permanent Makeup artist with a Diploma in Beauty Therapy & Diploma in Screen and Media (Specialist Makeup Services). You will find services at Basia Brow & Beauty such as Cosmetic Eyebrow Tattooing, Cosmetic Lip Tattooing, Beauty Services, and Makeup Services.

feeds.title: Hier Arch Blog
feeds.description: It is our mission to provide you with the knowledge and skills to become a stand-out brow artist by offering the most natural, in-demand techniques. Your skill set is the foundation for your career that will allow you to map and shape any brows that come your way with confidence. Our signature Brow and Microblading courses go through shaping and designing the perfect arches to suit your client's face.

feeds.title: Wow Eyebrows Blog
feeds.description: We are here to promote eyebrow threading a lifestyle based on a culture of love and respect for all colors & to celebrate the beauty within ourselves. The expertly trained artists at WOW EYEBROWS Albuquerque have the latest skills and knowledge in removing unwanted facial hair and shaping your brows to ULTIMATE perfection while ensuring the highest quality of service and prioritizing the health of your skin!

feeds.title: Eyebrow Queen Blog
feeds.description: Eyebrow Queen has been created as your brow beauty staple. It's about getting the best out of your natural brows. Each of my innovative and easy-to-use EyebrowQueen products has been designed to give you back your brows and your time and confidence.

feeds.title: The Brow Geek Blog
feeds.description: The Brow Geek is the home to Iconic Beauty Academy and the best brow products. Made by your favorite Brow tech, for all our favorite brow techs. The Brow Geek, has painstakingly created some products that are Cruelty free, Vegan Friendly, no parabens, no nasties and will help you to get rid of as many disposables as possible.

feeds.title: Essential Eyebrow Solution Blog
feeds.description: Essential Eyebrow Solution is a breakthrough clinically tested and patented botanical formulation developed to nourish, condition, and revitalize eyebrow hair, resulting in fuller, healthier-looking brows. With 30 years of experience in the beauty and hair loss industry, we can offer advice that will reshape the way you care for your eyebrows - which will reshape the way you look.

feeds.title: Lashbrow Artist » Eyebrow
feeds.description: At Lashbrow Artist, you can expect superior customer service. Our mission is to provide the highest quality beauty treatment at affordable prices to everyone. The strong client relationship and the growing clientele are a testament to our service. From brow tips and tricks to pro insights and more, the Eyebrow blog will cover it all.
